mapper.sql: SELECT ape_id, name, stream_source_type, direct_source_url, play_url, zlm_proxy_key, resource_type, sub_type, ip_addr, port, org_index, org_name, place_code, place, is_online, producer, producer_name, parent_code, zlm_server_id, sva_server_id, monitor_status, create_time, update_time FROM h_device
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO h_device (ape_id, name, stream_source_type, direct_source_url, play_url, zlm_proxy_key, resource_type, sub_type, ip_addr, port, org_index, org_name, place_code, place, is_online, producer, producer_name, parent_code, zlm_server_id, sva_server_id, monitor_status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{ape_id}, #{name}, IFNULL(UPPER(#{stream_source_type}), 'DIRECT'), #{direct_source_url}, #{play_url}, #{zlm_proxy_key}, #{resource_type}, #{sub_type}, #{ip_addr}, #{port}, #{org_index}, #{org_name}, #{place_code}, #{place}, #{is_online}, #{producer}, #{producer_name}, #{parent_code}, IFNULL(#{zlm_server_id}, 1), IFNULL(#{sva_server_id}, 1), IFNULL(#{monitor_status}, 'STOPPED'), #{create_time}, #{update_time})
